name: Aurora Cannabis Inc.
summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, distribution, and sale of cannabis products in Canada and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical-grade cannabis products; and medical and consumer cannabis products. It also provides harvested cannabis, trim, cannabis oils, capsules, edibles, vaporizers, dried and fresh cannabis, cannabis plants, cannabis seeds, edible cannabis, cannabis extracts, flowers, vapes / inhalable extracts, edibles / pastilles, concentrates, and cannabis topicals; and patient counseling and outreach services. Its brand portfolio includes Aurora, Being, CanniMed, CraftPlant, Daily Special, Drift, Greybeard, IndiMed, MedRelea…
